This role is responsible for ensuring effective equipment planning & procurement execution across purchasing, supplier coordination, logistics, procurement systems, processes, compliance, and performance management. This role will oversee and improve procurement processes, systems, reporting, supplier performance (E.g., OTD), and cross-functional coordination while partnering closely with Category Management and the Buyer/Planner. The Procurement Manager will work with Engineering, Tech Ops, Project Management, Delivery, O&M, Finance, Logistics, and external suppliers to support project execution and continuous improvement across the Procurement organization. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren. Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen. Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Join us and build the future of live entertainment.

The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Baseline the energetic materials requirements and material inventory across our products.
